meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Resend 收发邮件，把邮件线程变成独立的对话。
howto.when: 当你完成安装、配置好 Resend 的 API 密钥和 Webhook，并运行 /manage-channels 将邮件通道连接到代理组后触发。

say.text: 帮我给用户回复一封邮件，内容是“已收到您的请求”。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Resend 发送邮件。

say.text: 查看我最近的邮件对话。
say.note: Claude 会列出当前邮件线程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive emails via Resend, treating each email thread as a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you complete installation, configure Resend API key and webhook, and run /manage-channels to connect the email channel to an agent group.

say_en.text: Reply to the user with an email saying 'Your request has been received.'
say_en.note: Claude will send an email via Resend.

say_en.text: Show me my recent email conversations.
say_en.note: Claude will list current email threads.
